[Advertisement — electric cookers; Kielce.]
[P. 8, top centre, box between the columns; original in Polish]
Ladies buy only electric cookers!
Extraordinary convenience, cleanliness and safety! Low price
from 20 zł. Low energy cost. For cookers 15 gr. per 1 kWh.
Apply to
THE OFFICE OF THE POWER STATION IN KIELCE
at ul. Sienkiewicza No. 59.
—o—
[Advertisement — herbal remedy; no place given.]
[P. 8, ads block, top right; original in Yiddish, brand name in Polish]
A sick stomach
often causes various illnesses.
ZIOŁA z GÓR HARCU D-ra LAUERA [Dr. Lauer's Harz Mountain herbs]
are a good means of regulating the stomach; they remove
constipation, being [?] a mild natural purgative;
they remove the putrefying elements
that poison the body.
ZIOŁA z GÓR HARCU D-ra LAUERA
are also gladly used by those suffering from
liver, kidney, gallstone complaints and haemorrhoids [?].
[Picture: an elderly man in glasses with the figure of a monk behind him; artist's signature: kot]
—o—
[Advertisement — sewing machines; Sosnowiec.]
[P. 8, ads block, narrow right-hand column; original in Yiddish]
[Picture: sewing machine]
Let everyone
know
not to buy, sell
or exchange sewing machines until he
has visited the exhibited
cheap source of J. Adlerberg,
Sosnowiec, 3 Maja
Street 11a [?], where one can see various
Singer sewing machines;
"pereshkes" [?], "egzeloatsyes" [?] [unclear terms],
for ladies, for men, left- and
right-arm, also for shoemakers —
all as new, guaranteed. Dirt
cheap. Don't be late, just
come at once.
306 [?]
—o—
[Advertisement — printing works and bindery for sale; Chorzów.]
[P. 8, ads block, middle right; original in Polish]
Owing to departure, for sale:
A well-equipped printing works in operation,
with a fast press
and a platen press with electric drive, about 2000
kg of type, 9 type cabinets, as well as various
printing tools and a fully
equipped bookbindery, all in the best
condition. Price about 10,000 zł.
Enquiries: Chorzów (Król.-Huta)
P.O. Box 85.
1074 [?]
—o—
[Advertisement — the paper's own: subscription; Będzin.]
[P. 8, ads block, top centre; original in Yiddish]
Before you leave for
the dacha
— and —
health resorts
you must subscribe to the
"Zaglembier Tsaytung"
—o—
[Advertisement — anti-perspiration liquid; no place given.]
[P. 8, ads block, central strip; original in Polish]
SUDOR
liquid
"Ap. Kowalski" [Kowalski pharmacy]
removes
SWEAT
and odour.
Beware of imitations.
—o—
[Advertisement — guest house; Bystra near Biała.]
[P. 8, ads block, top left; original in Polish]
R. Frenkel's Guest House
410 Villa "Sielanka" tel. 24
BYSTRA near Biała
recommends sunny and comfortable rooms at
affordable prices. First-class cuisine.
Beautiful location. Running water,
English W.C., bathroom, radio etc.

[Notice — board of "Linat ha-Cholim"; Sosnowiec.]
[P. 8, ads block, left column middle; original in Yiddish]
For the sake of truth!
In connection with the accusations directed at
the house-owners [?] Messrs. M. Trieger and J. Szwajcer,
that they allegedly behaved tactlessly towards the "Linat ha-Cholim" society,
the new board has investigated the matter and come to the
conclusion that the accusations were malicious, owing to
personal ambitions of several board members
headed by the ex-president, in order to besmirch
the above-mentioned esteemed landlords, with whom we
are very satisfied as to further deeds for the good of our society.
As proof may serve the reduction of 15
zł. monthly from the fixed rent. 427
Board of "Linat ha-Cholim" in Sosnowiec.

L. Szancer
Targowa 5 [printed "Tagowa"]

—o—
[Notice — private appeal; Sosnowiec.]
[P. 8, ads block, bottom centre; original in Yiddish]
Have pity!
I turn with a heartfelt
request to the Jewish communal workers
of Sosnowiec to come to my aid
and prevail upon my husband Dovidl Buchbinder, Sosnowiec,
Czosna [?] 17, to stop his doings
and not destroy [?] a family that already has 2
children. It is indeed a crying injustice that one's
own father talks his son into abandoning
a wife with small children and matchmakes him
a second one. Jews, merciful sons of the merciful, respond!
Chaja Buchbinder.
—o—

"Reformation" pills
with the "Monk" trademark, known since [?] the year
1602, regulate the stomach, protect [?] against rheu-[?]
matism, liver complaints, against obesity,
